technical-summary: bc-serve serve|start|stop|status: a C++ session owner for engine-only configs (RSC02 step 1). Session lock, control socket and record; the build's own --write-manifest with the measure (exit 10) and derived-pool (exit 11) rounds; engine from the manifest with a scrubbed environment; /health and canary; group-verified stop; orphan detection by process start time; same-build check. qwen27b config states the launcher's engine-only values.
user-summary-candidate: Engine-only models can be started, checked and stopped with bc-serve serve/start/status/stop from a named config, without the bash launcher.
